requirements.statement: Implement the keel.repository-intelligence/v1 canonical graph with repository-relative identities, deterministic UTF-8 JSON serialization, typed relationships, direct/normalized/derived provenance, validation, and representable cycles.
Implement evidence-backed command intelligence with independent existence, source class, provenance, support, runtime availability, authorization, precedence, and exact negative classifications.
Implement ownership, architecture-source, and freshness intelligence with authority precedence, conflict/ambiguity handling, historical classification, and no invented owners or authority.
requirements.source: P1 ExecPlan authority and freshness contract

requirements.statement: Implement bounded dependency intelligence using only evidenced adapters, preserving direct/derived/external/generated/unresolved/unsupported distinctions, malformed failures, incomplete evidence, and cycles.
Implement normalized changed-path and read-only impact intelligence that preserves uncertainty, conflicts, ownership, architecture, dependency, and generated provenance without authorizing effects.
requirements.source: P1 ExecPlan changed-path and impact contract

requirements.statement: Implement generated-artifact producer provenance and drift classification, rejecting hand-maintained generated claims and preserving missing, stale, and conflicting producer outcomes without mutation.
Keep P1 stack-agnostic and read-only, never fabricate unsupported facts, never use machine-local identities, and do not instantiate P2–P7 or execute D1/runtime/external effects.
requirements.source: P1 ExecPlan scope and effects boundary

requirements.statement: Provide independent behavioral fixtures and expected-output oracles covering every required positive and negative P1 classification, and pass repository-native regressions and strict lifecycle verification.
